search.objective: Test the interaction between targeted post-antenna buffering and rerouting/antenna repair; preserve the baseline SDC and all final checks

_why: Baseline OpenDB identifies two clock drivers over 16 sinks and two data drivers at 17 because antenna repair added a diode to a 16-load net. Split only internal single-driver nets above the same limit, legalize, reroute and repair antenna again. Extra antenna iterations and margin are part of this physical repair interaction, not changes to signoff limits.
